response.sql: WITH operator_stats AS (SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) AS scan_count, AVG(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS gb_per_minute FROM scans GROUP BY crewref), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_minute) AS all_operator_gb_per_minute FROM operator_stats) SELECT AVG(scan_count) AS average_scan_count, AVG(gb_per_minute) AS average_gb_per_minute, AVG(gb_per_minute - all_operator_gb_per_minute) AS average_excess_gb_per_minute FROM operator_stats CROSS JOIN benchmark WHERE gb_per_minute > all_operator_gb_per_minute;

assumptions.assumption: A scan means one row in scans. Missing file sizes or durations, and zero durations, are excluded from rate calculations; all rows count toward scan count.

alternatives.interpretation: If 'how many scans' means the total of scans.scancount across each operator's scan sets, average those totals instead of counting rows.
alternatives.sql: WITH operator_stats AS (SELECT crewref, SUM(scancount) AS scan_count, AVG(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS gb_per_minute FROM scans GROUP BY crewref), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_minute) AS all_operator_gb_per_minute FROM operator_stats) SELECT AVG(scan_count) AS average_scan_count, AVG(gb_per_minute) AS average_gb_per_minute, AVG(gb_per_minute - all_operator_gb_per_minute) AS average_excess_gb_per_minute FROM operator_stats CROSS JOIN benchmark WHERE gb_per_minute > all_operator_gb_per_minute;
